title: Chapter 1303
text:
The fragments of the past revealed by (Bold Explorer) brought a huge amount of information. Han Xiao could not help but feel shocked and curious.

His understanding of the World Tree Civilization only came from the war version in his previous life. He only had a rough idea of the specific history of the World Tree Civilization, mainly because the information the players in his previous life knew was limited.

However, he was still clear about some basic information. The process of the World Tree Civilization's development was basically a history of war. They constantly explored the universe, conquered, and destroyed countless civilizations and races. The three Universal Civilizations were not the first to be discovered, and from the perspective of the World Tree, they were not special. They were just another prey on the path of conquest.

Through the illusion earlier, Han Xiao roughly pieced together the ins and outs of this mechanical body.

This unknown civilization should be the overlord of a certain area in the unexplored universe. The scale shown in the illusion was not inferior to any of the three Universal Civilizations. The three Universal Civilizations occupied the explored universe and only ruled this area. There were also other civilizations in the vast unexplored universe, so the three Universal Civilizations had always been exploring and expanding their territory.

Although the explored universe had already entered the galactic society era, if one were to zoom in infinitely, the entire universe was still in the 'exploration era'.

In the past, the World Tree discovered this unknown civilization, so it crossed the starry sky and invaded, starting a war and slowly encroaching on the other party's territory. The World Tree's invasion method was not a simple occupation. Most of the time, it devoured the enemy's planets completely. Like a Taotie, it ate everything, only entering and not leaving. Therefore, it was almost impossible to recover the lost territory.

The opponent either resisted the attack or retreated in defeat. The more they fought, the fewer planets that produced resources would become nutrients for the World Tree. It was a vicious cycle. In Han Xiao's previous life, the three Universal Civilizations had faced the same situation.

Clearly, this unknown civilization was no match for the World Tree in terms of military strength, so they tried to find a breakthrough in terms of individual strength. Countless Mechanics willingly sacrificed themselves, using the Beyond Grade A individual as the core. Through some kind of strange fusion technology, they tried to create an even stronger individual.

Although the source of the information was only an illusion, Han Xiao felt that the goal of this unknown civilization should be to artificially create a Super that surpassed the Beyond Grade A realm and become a breakthrough for the overall situation!

However, the illusion did not show whether it was successful or not. It only knew that the final result was that the body was destroyed, fell into a black hole, and disappeared. It did not fall into the hands of the World Tree, and this unknown civilization was destroyed in the end. Even the universe where it was located was devoured without leaving any traces, becoming another sacrifice under the World Tree.

"What a terrifying enemy …"

Han Xiao mourned for this unknown civilization for a few seconds and sighed softly.

For a civilization to develop to the scale of a universal civilization, who knew how many changes and disasters they had to go through. Along the way, they had created a brilliant and resplendent culture, but the legacy and hard work of countless generations had been destroyed so easily, vanishing from the universe.

Countless years of hard work, all gone in one day.

Although he had seen the terror of the World Tree Civilization before, seeing this scene again, Han Xiao still felt quite a bit of pressure, and his mood was solemn.

If he did not know how terrifying the other party was, he would not have tried his best to delay the arrival of the World Tree. Even if he had many trump cards that he did not have in his previous life, he did not dare say that he could win this war with absolute confidence.

Now is not the time to worry about this. What will come will come. It's just a matter of time …

Han Xiao shook his head, exhaled softly, and placed his attention back on the body.

"This big guy's level is very high, probably above four hundred, but it doesn't seem to have reached a higher level …"

Han Xiao pondered.

Although he had not entered a higher level yet, he had a lot of experience. The God's Trait Transformation should be a barrier that he could not avoid.

This unknown civilization's path was to forcefully induce a qualitative change and complete the promotion. Therefore, they sacrificed a bunch of Mechanics, but the life level of this body did not seem to have evolved.

Even if Han Xiao did not understand the technical principles of this unknown civilization for the time being, it did not stop him from intuitively feeling that this path had gone astray. It was more like a desperate attempt to make a gamble.

Therefore, the total level of this thing was most likely false. It was like having multiple 'subclasses', with many levels taken away, and its actual combat strength did not undergo an earth-shattering transformation.

However, there was definitely improvement, and it might have touched the edge of a higher level … However, it was still destroyed by the World Tree, which was a little scary.

"However, this body contains the essence of a large number of Mechanics from an unknown civilization. If I reverse engineer it, I should be able to derive a lot of new technology, especially this kind of strange fusion technology. It's similar to the Felons, but it's on a different path …"

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

The value of this body might not be inferior to Jayz's technology treasures. There were the technological essences of different Mechanics everywhere.

Among them, the most valuable should be this fusion technology. He might not be able to use it, but he might be able to comprehend it and come up with something new.

Just as he was thinking, Aurora, who was beside him, saw that Han Xiao did not say anything after studying it for a long time.

She could not help but ask, "Did you find anything?"

Han Xiao came back to his senses, nodded, and said with a smile, "You've given me a surprise this time."

As he spoke, he looked deeply at Fu Ding, and his smile became even wider.

To be able to encounter something like this, Fu Ding was indeed his lucky star!

He guessed that this body had finally fallen into the explored universe through a wormhole after wandering around for a while.

This Star Field was called Blackhole Edge, and it was where large wormholes frequently appeared. This was not rare.

In his previous life, this body had not been exposed, but it might not have been encountered by others. It was also possible that it had not been thrown into the explored universe by the wormhole. This should have nothing to do with his butterfly effect. After all, wormholes were highly random.

And now, this big guy had been encountered by Fu Ding … Han Xiao could only sigh at Fu Ding's luck. He was like a walking 'miracle trigger'.

Aurora walked over and pestered Han Xiao to get to the bottom of it. Han Xiao thought for a while and omitted most of the origin. He then vaguely explained the nature of this mechanical body, pretending that it was a result obtained through technical analysis.

"So, this big guy should be heavily injured and hibernating now?"

Aurora's eyes turned, and she was eager to try.

"Then, do you want me to inject life force into it and let it recover?"

As soon as she said that, before Han Xiao could answer, the interface suddenly moved, and a notification popped up.

You have triggered the hidden mission [Visitor from Afar]!

Mission Introduction: You accidentally discovered the remains of a strange body from an unknown civilization. This body still has weak signs of life, and it seems to hide many secrets. You might be able to obtain some valuable information from it.

Mission Requirements: Repair the body and wake it up.

Basic Reward: 50 billion EXP, 2 Random Rewards, 1 Character Summon Card.

Additional Reward depends on Mission Rating, which depends on the degree of repair.

Remarks: This mission might affect the development of certain events, causing unpredictable effects. Please choose carefully.

There's still a mission like this?

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes.

This body was now in an unconscious state, and it was severely damaged. He did not know if it still had its own consciousness. If it was healed, there would be many more unstable factors.

On one hand, the information about the World Tree would probably be spread by this guy. On the other hand, this guy's strength was unknown, and it might be a threat. The unknown impact of the mission note should be due to these two considerations.

Furthermore, this body had recovered its ability to move, so how was he going to reverse engineer it? Of course, a body that could not move was the most convenient to study. He could put it in whatever position he wanted!

Logically speaking, Han Xiao did not intend to be disrupted by this mission. He shook his head.

"No need. Let's maintain the status quo first. I'll pull this thing back and study it thoroughly."

"Alright then, call me when you need me." Aurora did not have any objections.

Although she was the first person to discover this body, she did not mind letting Han Xiao handle it. The situation was sensitive now, and she did not want to cause trouble for Han Xiao.

Han Xiao nodded, came to the edge of this long and narrow wound, and tried to open the secondary dimensional army box outside.

Mechanical Force arcs jumped and flashed like golden snakes dancing in the sky. A space door was opened, and a large number of mechanical soldiers flew out. This strange domain only sealed the movement of the main universe environment and did not seal the secondary dimensions like the Celestial Star Alliance's dimension.

Very soon, these mechanical soldiers spread out and moved on the surface of the body like ants, looking for the core device that maintained this domain.

Han Xiao planned to retrieve this body first to prevent it from drifting in the universe and being discovered by someone. This space sealed the normal movement, but it did not seal the quantum network. Otherwise, Aurora would not have been able to send news back so easily.

Scan reports were sent to Han Xiao one after another. Not long after, the entire body was scanned. Most of the mechanical devices in the body were dormant, and only a small area deep in the chest was still operating. One of the devices was the device to activate the domain.

The mechanical soldiers quickly drilled a hole in the body's chest and turned off the device from the inside.

Buzz!

The next moment, the domain closed, and the dark space around disappeared, returning to the normal starry sky.

"It's unlocked."

Han Xiao nodded, summoned the construction machinery team, and set up the wormhole guide, setting the coordinates to the Mechanical Life Civilization in the Black Star Corps' territory.

After a while, a huge wormhole appeared in front of him, and the mechanical army pushed the body into the wormhole. A few minutes later, Han Xiao received a message from Psionic Prime confirming that he had received the goods.

Only then did Han Xiao recall all his troops and clean up the scene. He then turned to look at Aurora, nodded, and smiled.

"Your discovery this time is very helpful to me. I'll remember it."

Aurora's eyes sparkled. "Is there any reward?"

"What do you want? As long as it's not too much, I can agree to anything. "

"Hmm … I haven't thought about it yet. I'll tell you when I've thought about it." Aurora giggled.

"Alright, I'll take it as I owe you a request."

Han Xiao shook his head helplessly, changed into the King, and teleported home. He could not wait to study the technological secrets of the polymerized body.

He had a feeling that he might be able to obtain unexpected gains from this body.

Aurora and Fu Ding remained where they were and stared at each other.

After half a minute, Aurora said, "What are you looking at?

Why aren't you driving the ship? "

"… Are we still going to continue traveling?" Fu Ding's mouth twitched.

"Of course! This time, I've helped Black Star again. Who knows, I might find something new next time! "

Aurora was very excited.

She had lived under the protection of Black Star and Hella for too long, and she had always wanted to help Han Xiao. Now that she had finally made a contribution, she felt very motivated, and her passion for exploration continued to rise.

"Can we switch Nero over?" Fu Ding said weakly.

He had already followed Aurora outside for more than a year. He had a home but could not return, so he had learned to be Yu the Great.

If he had known that he would be used as a tool by Aurora for so long, he would not have separated Chen Xing from him. What was supposed to be a good relationship had now become a long-distance relationship …

If one were to ask how he felt, he would say that he regretted it!

—
